attributes.title: tag_update
attributes.description: Merge a configuration change into existing Tags via system.tag.configure with the handler-fixed MergeOverwrite collision policy. Each item carries the target path, the tcf1 Tag config fingerprint of that target's own tag_get_config read, and the configuration to merge. Reads the Runtime Target Policy first and fails closed with operation_disabled when it is missing or unusable; a target outside the tag_update Target allowlist, inside the reserved IgnitionMCPPolicy provider (whatever the allowlist says, including an explicit *), or a UDT definition without an explicit _types_ allowlist entry fails with permission_denied before anything executes. Preflight validates every item's input and Target and compares every fingerprint before any item executes: a stale fingerprint is conflict and a missing target is not_found, so this Tool never creates one. An item never writes a Tag value (that is tag_write), never changes a name (that is tag_rename) and never carries nested children (each child is its own target with its own fingerprint). Runtime audit follows the policy's auditMode; a failed post-Mutation audit write gives auditRecorded=false, never a failure. The re-read configuration is Observed state and never decides success.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: 1..100 update items: {"path": provider-qualified Tag, Folder or UDT definition config path, "expectedFingerprint": the tcf1 fingerprint from tag_get_config for that exact path, "config": the configuration properties to merge}. Default 20 (D10), hard maximum 100.
